name: Timbermaw Ally
label: Quest
description: Timbermaw Ally: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.

Are you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Keep at it, friend. If you are to earn our trust, you will need to prove yourself to us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We suffer much from the events of the past. Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw. As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.
